firm_data.firm_description: Zarin & Steinmetz is known throughout the New York metropolitan area and Hudson Valley for its concentration in all aspects of land development. They represent private and municipal clients in zoning and land use, SEQRA, environmental law, real estate and business transactions, eminent domain, and litigation in state and federal courts.
notable_facts: The firm represents both private and municipal clients.
The firm is known for its expertise in land development in the New York metropolitan area and the Hudson Valley.

email.subject: AI for Zarin & Steinmetz - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi David,

Your firm's reputation for land development expertise across the New York metropolitan area and Hudson Valley is impressive, especially given how complex SEQRA and zoning matters demand precision work on lean resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your White Plains office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
